baselines.paper: Comparison-based Active Preference Learning for Multi-dimensional Personalization (AMPLe)
baselines.blocker: Full README run is n_rounds=100 with burnin=50000; only n_rounds was shortened to 3. README --dims 0 1 would request minhyeonoh/feedback_assistant_harmlesshelpful_271 (HTTP 401 / not public), so --dims was omitted to load the public 3-aspect dataset. Torch/datasets/wandb/accelerate were installed in an isolated venv, not the main project venv. WANDB_MODE=offline. Acquisition remained volume; burnin remained 50000.
baselines.comparability: NOT DIRECTLY COMPARABLE to Idea A Neyman-audit IPW. AMPLe optimizes multi-dimensional preference identification via volume/random acquisition on RM-scored pairs. Different target, budget, and information.

baselines.paper: Hybrid Preferences: Learning to Route Instances for Human vs. AI Feedback (HyPER)
baselines.blocker: Pre-declared. Official pipeline needs Google Cloud TPU v3-128, EasyLM RM/DPO training of Tulu-2 13B / Llama-3.1-8B, vLLM (>=0.4.1; forbidden), Beaker, GCS, and submodules open-instruct + reward-bench (not initialized). Clone without submodules was 632K and was kept. No simplified HyPER was invented.
baselines.comparability: NOT DIRECTLY COMPARABLE. HyPER routes human vs LM annotations to maximize downstream RM / RewardBench scores.
